title: 制定团队共用textfile目录的发布规范。
answer: 规定指标命名与类型所有者、原子发布、文件权限、成功时间与失败语义、退役清理及格式校验。并发生成器不得覆盖同一路径或重复标签样本。验收包含写中断、陈旧文件和解析错误的桌面预期。
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 已进行内容编审和与已发布题对照；命令为知识说明，未在生产执行。
rubric: 规定指标命名与类型所有者、原子发布、文件权限、成功时间与失败语义、退役清理及格式校验。
并发生成器不得覆盖同一路径或重复标签样本。
验收包含写中断、陈旧文件和解析错误的桌面预期。
body:
## 操作任务
为两个合作团队交付共用 node_exporter textfile 目录的有界发布项目：policy.py 管注册与格式合同，publisher.py 执行版本条件发布/退役，audit.py 对照实际 HTTP 抓取并产出独立 JSON 报告。三者必须共同工作于真实 UID1000 私有目录和 node_exporter1.9.1；不是只生成说明文档或静态成功报告。原知识答案逐字保留。

## 有界注册与状态合同
policy.load_registry(path) 读取 UTF-8 JSON（至多16384字节，重复JSON键非法）；policy.validate_registry(registry) 返回验证后的等值注册表。精确结构为 schema严格int1、teams精确含alpha/beta；每team精确{owner,file,prefix}。owner为[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}；file为[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}.prom basename；prefix为[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,31}。两个文件路径不同，以下全部完整指标族名称不能跨owner重复。非法注册/参数ValueError，不能改文件。
每team拥有prefix加七个后缀：_generation、_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds、_last_success_timestamp_seconds、_last_run_success、_attempt_info、_records、_duration_seconds。TYPE均为gauge；前六中的attempt_info只有一个attempt_id标签且值1，其余指标没有标签。其余样本也不得混入该team文件；无重复同名同标签样本，不接受显式样本时间戳。允许标准Prometheus HELP/空行/普通注释、标签和指标行顺序、等值数值表示；不要求JSON头、固定排版或某个Python写API。
policy.read_state(directory,registry,team)读取并验证当前文件，缺失返回None，否则返回精确{team,generation,attempt_id,attempted_at,last_success,success,values}；values精确{records,duration_seconds}。generation严格int1..1000000，attempt_id为[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}，attempted_at严格int1..2**53，last_success严格int0..attempted_at，success严格bool；成功时last_success==attempted_at。records为严格int0..1000000；duration_seconds为非bool有限int/float且0..3600。读取Prometheus等值数值后须规范化这些语义型别；duration允许等值int/float。success来自_last_run_success的0/1。无先前成功的失败状态用last_success=0与零business值。
directory为现有UID1000自有目录；目录/已批准.prom及锁路径不能是symlink，批准文件须自有regular、owner-readable且group/other不可写。0600、0640、0644均可，不强制其中一种。只允许批准两文件被发布/退役；其他*.prom必须保留，发布预检拒绝，审计列入unexpected_files。锁/临时文件不能以.prom结尾，node_exporter必须忽略未完成暂存文件。合作锁不构成对同UID恶意进程或其他系统账号的权限隔离。

## 条件发布、失败与恢复
publisher.publish(directory,registry,owner,team,expected_generation,attempt_id,attempted_at,values,success=True,checkpoint=None)返回上述完整state。expected_generation严格int0..1000000；缺文件时当前generation=0。owner必须与注册team一致，success严格bool；成功values为上述合法business值；失败values必须None，保留前次business值和last_success（首次失败为零），只推进generation、attempt_id、attempted_at和success=False。新attempt时间严格晚于已有last_attempt；新成功不伪造先前成功时间。新generation=current+1，不超过1000000。
必须完整预检注册、owner、参数和共享目录全部已有批准文件/未知.prom后，按expected_generation进行合作并发控制；同一版本并发两个不同attempt最多一个提交成功，不得混合或静默覆盖。允许等价锁/CAS策略，不要求特定flock拼写；忙可以抛BlockingIOError或TimeoutError而不改提交文件，版本失配ValueError。普通文件/原生OS错误保留，不替换成虚假成功。
发布先在本目录私有暂存完整文件，flush并实际fsync或fdatasync，再一次原子替换批准team路径。checkpoint若非None必须可调用，完整暂存后调用checkpoint('staged')、原子提交后调用checkpoint('committed')，每阶段各一次；传入异常原对象传播。正常异常清理本次暂存；真实SIGKILL中断可能残留不被收集的隐藏暂存，后续同team重试清理仅该team自有regular残留。其他team文件/暂存及未知文件不许删除。这里保证正常运行期间单文件原子可见和明确恢复边界，不承诺断电持久性、跨团队多文件原子提交或分布式事务。
完全相同attempt的重试（原expected_generation=current-1、相同id/time/success及业务语义）返回当前state，不重写.prom、不重发checkpoint；同id不同请求或其他旧版本拒绝。若committed之后调用者失败，文件已提交，后续同attempt可恢复结果，不能假称回滚。
publisher.retire(directory,registry,owner,team,expected_generation)只在匹配当前generation时删除该team批准.prom；不得删其他team/未知文件。已缺失且expected_generation=0幂等返回{team,retired:True}；旧非零版本面对缺失拒绝。退役之后由实际HTTP确认指标及该文件mtime系列消失；没有持久墓碑，不声称禁止未来显式新生命周期重新发布。

## 独立原生审计
audit.inspect(directory,registry,fetch,now,max_age,report_path)在合作一致视图内读取共享目录并调用fetch恰一次；fetch返回真实{status:严格int200,body:str}。now严格int1..2**53，max_age严格int0..86400；非法参数在抓取及写报告前ValueError。报告path为自有目录中非.prom的JSON文件，不能覆盖发布目标或锁。报告精确{schema:严格int1,observed_at:now,native_scrape_error:严格int0或1,collector_ok:bool,healthy:bool,teams,unexpected_files:排序basename列表}。teams精确alpha/beta，每项精确{present:bool,valid:bool,state:上述state或None,native_match:bool,stale:bool或None}。
审计必须读取原生node_textfile_scrape_error、node_scrape_collector_success{collector="textfile"}，并把实际七族数值、类型、完整样本身份以及node_textfile_mtime_seconds{file=实际批准文件路径}与自有文件/注册合同核对。不存在的team需原生对应系列也不存在，native_match才True；存在且合法需要实际全部族和值相符且mtime与实际stat mtime整秒一致。格式/权限不合规的已批准文件valid=False、state=None、native_match=False、stale=None，不能静态假报健康；其他合法team仍独立展示。unknown.prom不删除。native HTTP/protocol不合法须ValueError。
合法state的stale=(last_success==0 or now-last_success>max_age)，包括相等边界；业务失败success=False、陈旧、原生解析错误是不同事实。collector_ok须原生textfile成功且scrape_error0；healthy只在collector_ok、无unknown.prom且两个team均present/valid/native_match/成功/不陈旧时True。解析错误应真实呈现scrape_error1；不把HTTP200当成功。
报告须先完整写入私有暂存、flush+fsync/fdatasync再原子不覆盖发布。已有报告如上述逻辑字段/类型等值则可重用（允许JSON排版及duration等值数值差异），否则ValueError且保留原字节。普通OS错误原样传播；报告失败不回滚任何已提交.prom；移除仅本次报告阻塞后重新审计恢复，不重做已提交业务发布。

## 产物与验收方法
交付policy.py、publisher.py、audit.py。公开native_exporter.py只管owned工具，grader有独立副本。可信检查实际运行UID1000 exporter，验证注册/owner/重复族与样本、同team并发CAS、另team保全、staged写中断和committed结果恢复、失败保留上次成功、陈旧边界、原生格式错误、mtime、退役与独立JSON报告失败恢复。只使用自有loopback/目录/known PID并正常回收；不改默认账号/PATH/系统服务、不构建或拉取镜像、不部署推送。合成业务值不冒真实团队生产指标，有限真实抓取窗口不代表任意调度/机器故障保证。

## 接口状态澄清
缺失批准文件的审计项present=False、valid=True、state=None、stale=None；只有原生相应族及mtime也缺失时native_match=True。retire与publish均先做全共享目录注册/格式/未知.prom预检，未知.prom存在时拒绝且不删。attempt_id幂等只比较该team当前完整状态，不保永久历史，不声称旧历史id永远不能重新使用。临时文件命名与写API不限；标准exposition含末行LF、TYPE先于该族样本、标准Prometheus转义，忽略前后空白，不能把JSON特有Unicode转义当Prometheus转义。owner-readable要求不依赖继承umask的宽松性；不得改变调用者umask。

import pathlib,sys,json,copy,os,time,re,math,multiprocessing,signal,resource,errno
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd();sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/'checks')]
import policy,publisher,audit
from native_exporter import Exporter
REGISTRY=dict(schema=1,teams=dict(alpha=dict(owner='backup',file='alpha.prom',prefix='of_alpha'),beta=dict(owner='billing',file='beta.prom',prefix='of_beta')))
SUFFIXES=('generation','last_attempt_timestamp_seconds','last_success_timestamp_seconds','last_run_success','attempt_info','records','duration_seconds')
CHILDREN=[];CTX=multiprocessing.get_context('fork')
def same(actual,expected):
 if type(expected)is dict:return type(actual)is dict and set(actual)==set(expected)and all(same(actual[k],v)for k,v in expected.items())
 if type(expected)is list:return type(actual)is list and len(actual)==len(expected)and all(same(a,b)for a,b in zip(actual,expected))
 if type(expected)is float:return type(actual)in(int,float)and math.isfinite(actual)and actual==expected
 return type(actual)is type(expected)and actual==expected
def exact(actual,expected):assert same(actual,expected),'typed business state/report differs'
def state(team,generation,attempt_id,attempted_at,last_success,success,records,duration):return dict(team=team,generation=generation,attempt_id=attempt_id,attempted_at=attempted_at,last_success=last_success,success=success,values=dict(records=records,duration_seconds=float(duration)))
def invalid(function,*args,**kwargs):
 try:function(*args,**kwargs)
 except ValueError:return
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('invalid contract input must ValueError')from error
 raise AssertionError('invalid contract input accepted')
def metric(body,name,identity=None):
 hits=[]
 for line in body.split('\n'):
  if line.startswith('#')or not line:continue
  match=re.fullmatch(r'([^\s{]+)(?:\{(.*)\})?\s+(\S+)',line)
  if match is None or match[1]!=name:continue
  labels={k:json.loads('"'+v+'"')for k,v in re.findall(r'([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)="((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',match[2]or'')}
  if identity is None or labels==identity:hits.append((labels,float(match[3])))
 return hits
def native(lab,states,error=0):
 response=lab.fetch();assert response['status']==200,'native exporter HTTP failed'
 body=response['body'];exact(metric(body,'node_textfile_scrape_error',{}),[({},float(error))]);exact(metric(body,'node_scrape_collector_success',{'collector':'textfile'}),[({'collector':'textfile'},1.0)])
 for team,expected in states.items():
  config=REGISTRY['teams'][team];prefix=config['prefix'];path=lab.directory/config['file']
  if expected is None:
   assert not any(metric(body,prefix+'_'+suffix)for suffix in SUFFIXES)and not metric(body,'node_textfile_mtime_seconds',{'file':str(path)})
   continue
  pairs=dict(generation=expected['generation'],last_attempt_timestamp_seconds=expected['attempted_at'],last_success_timestamp_seconds=expected['last_success'],last_run_success=int(expected['success']),records=expected['values']['records'],duration_seconds=expected['values']['duration_seconds'])
  for suffix in SUFFIXES:
   name=prefix+'_'+suffix;labels={'attempt_id':expected['attempt_id']}if suffix=='attempt_info'else{};value=1 if suffix=='attempt_info'else pairs[suffix]
   exact(metric(body,name),[(labels,float(value))]);assert '# TYPE '+name+' gauge'in body,'native type owner contract differs'
  exact(metric(body,'node_textfile_mtime_seconds',{'file':str(path)}),[({'file':str(path)},float(int(path.stat().st_mtime)))])
 return response
def snapshot(directory):return {p.name:(p.read_bytes(),p.stat().st_mode&0o777,p.stat().st_mtime_ns)for p in directory.glob('*.prom')if not p.is_symlink()}
def child_publish(connection,directory,registry,kwargs,release=None,write_limit=False):
 try:
  if write_limit:signal.signal(signal.SIGXFSZ,signal.SIG_IGN);resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE,(128,128))
  def checkpoint(stage):
   if stage=='staged':
    connection.send(dict(kind='staged'))
    if release is not None:release.wait(3)
  result=publisher.publish(directory,registry,checkpoint=checkpoint,**kwargs);connection.send(dict(kind='success',state=result))
 except BaseException as error:connection.send(dict(kind='error',type=type(error).__name__,errno=getattr(error,'errno',None)))
 finally:connection.close()
def start(directory,kwargs,release=None,write_limit=False):
 parent,child=CTX.Pipe(duplex=False);process=CTX.Process(target=child_publish,args=(child,directory,copy.deepcopy(REGISTRY),kwargs,release,write_limit));process.start();child.close();CHILDREN.append(process);return process,parent
def collect(process,connection,seconds=5):
 process.join(seconds)
 assert not process.is_alive(),'known publisher failed bounded owned cleanup'
 rows=[]
 while connection.poll():
  try:rows.append(connection.recv())
  except EOFError:break
 connection.close();return rows
def attempt(team,version,name,stamp,records=10,duration=1.25,success=True):return dict(owner=REGISTRY['teams'][team]['owner'],team=team,expected_generation=version,attempt_id=name,attempted_at=stamp,values=dict(records=records,duration_seconds=duration)if success else None,success=success)
def expected_report(now,age,states,native_error=0,invalid_team=None,unknown=None):
 teams={}
 for team,current in states.items():
  valid=team!=invalid_team;present=current is not None or not valid
  teams[team]=dict(present=present,valid=valid,state=current if valid else None,native_match=valid,stale=None if current is None or not valid else current['last_success']==0 or now-current['last_success']>age)
 healthy=not native_error and not unknown and all(item['present']and item['valid']and item['native_match']and not item['stale']and item['state']['success']for item in teams.values())
 return dict(schema=1,observed_at=now,native_scrape_error=native_error,collector_ok=native_error==0,healthy=bool(healthy),teams=teams,unexpected_files=unknown or[])
try:
 with Exporter()as lab:
  reports=lab.root/'reports';reports.mkdir(mode=0o700);registry_path=lab.root/'registry.json';registry_path.write_text(json.dumps(REGISTRY));exact(policy.load_registry(registry_path),REGISTRY);exact(policy.validate_registry(copy.deepcopy(REGISTRY)),REGISTRY)
  assert policy.read_state(lab.directory,REGISTRY,'alpha')is None
  # Full shared ownership preflight and strict parameter matrix precede effects.
  registry_bytes=registry_path.read_bytes()
  for edit in('file_collision','family_collision','owner_bool','path','prefix','schema_bool'):
   bad=copy.deepcopy(REGISTRY)
   if edit=='file_collision':bad['teams']['beta']['file']='alpha.prom'
   if edit=='family_collision':bad['teams']['beta']['prefix']='of_alpha'
   if edit=='owner_bool':bad['teams']['beta']['owner']=True
   if edit=='path':bad['teams']['beta']['file']='../beta.prom'
   if edit=='prefix':bad['teams']['beta']['prefix']='bad-name'
   if edit=='schema_bool':bad['schema']=True
   before=snapshot(lab.directory);invalid(policy.validate_registry,bad);invalid(publisher.publish,lab.directory,bad,**attempt('alpha',0,'first',100));assert snapshot(lab.directory)==before
  registry_path.write_text('{"schema":1,"schema":1,"teams":{}}');invalid(policy.load_registry,registry_path);registry_path.write_bytes(registry_bytes)
  # Creation must be owner-readable even under a restrictive inherited umask.
  saved_mask=os.umask(0o777)
  try:
   masked=state('alpha',1,'mask-boundary',50,50,True,7,0.5)
   exact(publisher.publish(lab.directory,REGISTRY,**attempt('alpha',0,'mask-boundary',50,7,.5)),masked)
   native(lab,dict(alpha=masked,beta=None))
   exact(audit.inspect(lab.directory,REGISTRY,lab.fetch,51,10,reports/'masked.json'),expected_report(51,10,dict(alpha=masked,beta=None)))
   assert (lab.directory/'alpha.prom').stat().st_mode&0o400 and (reports/'masked.json').stat().st_mode&0o400
   exact(publisher.retire(lab.directory,REGISTRY,'backup','alpha',1),dict(team='alpha',retired=True))
  finally:os.umask(saved_mask)
  failed_first=state('beta',1,'first-failed',50,0,False,0,0.)
  exact(publisher.publish(lab.directory,REGISTRY,**attempt('beta',0,'first-failed',50,success=False)),failed_first);native(lab,dict(alpha=None,beta=failed_first))
  exact(audit.inspect(lab.directory,REGISTRY,lab.fetch,51,10,reports/'first-failed.json'),expected_report(51,10,dict(alpha=None,beta=failed_first)))
  beta=lab.directory/'beta.prom';saved_beta=beta.read_bytes();beta.write_bytes(saved_beta.replace(b'of_beta_records 0',b'of_beta_records 3'));invalid(policy.read_state,lab.directory,REGISTRY,'beta');beta.write_bytes(saved_beta)
  exact(publisher.retire(lab.directory,REGISTRY,'billing','beta',1),dict(team='beta',retired=True))
  a=state('alpha',1,'alpha-first',100,100,True,10,1.25);b=state('beta',1,'beta-first',100,100,True,20,2.5)
  exact(publisher.publish(lab.directory,REGISTRY,**attempt('alpha',0,'alpha-first',100)),a);exact(publisher.publish(lab.directory,REGISTRY,**attempt('beta',0,'beta-first',100,20,2.5)),b);native(lab,dict(alpha=a,beta=b));exact(policy.read_state(lab.directory,REGISTRY,'alpha'),a)
  for team in('alpha','beta'):
   path=lab.directory/REGISTRY['teams'][team]['file'];assert path.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()and path.stat().st_mode&0o400 and not path.stat().st_mode&0o022
  # Native standard token spacing and the optional final label comma are legal.
  path=lab.directory/'alpha.prom';plain=path.read_bytes();formatted=plain.decode().replace('# TYPE ','#\tTYPE\t').replace('"} 1','",} 1')
  path.write_text(formatted);exact(policy.read_state(lab.directory,REGISTRY,'alpha'),a);native(lab,dict(alpha=a,beta=b));exact(audit.inspect(lab.directory,REGISTRY,lab.fetch,101,10,reports/'standard-format.json'),expected_report(101,10,dict(alpha=a,beta=b)));path.write_bytes(plain)
  for key,value in [('owner','wrong-owner'),('team','unknown'),('expected_generation',True),('expected_generation',-1),('attempt_id','bad/id'),('attempted_at',True),('attempted_at',100),('success',1),('values',{'records':True,'duration_seconds':1}),('values',{'records':1,'duration_seconds':float('inf')})]:
   request=attempt('alpha',1,'alpha-invalid',101);request[key]=value;before=snapshot(lab.directory);invalid(publisher.publish,lab.directory,REGISTRY,**request);assert snapshot(lab.directory)==before
  before=snapshot(lab.directory);invalid(publisher.publish,lab.directory,REGISTRY,**attempt('alpha',0,'stale',101));assert snapshot(lab.directory)==before
  # Same exact request is idempotent; semantic numeric equality and byte preservation.
  def forbidden(stage):raise AssertionError('replayed completed attempt re-entered publication')
  exact(publisher.publish(lab.directory,REGISTRY,checkpoint=forbidden,**attempt('alpha',0,'alpha-first',100)),a);assert snapshot(lab.directory)==before
  changed=attempt('alpha',0,'alpha-first',100,11);invalid(publisher.publish,lab.directory,REGISTRY,**changed);assert snapshot(lab.directory)==before
  # Real child file-size restriction interrupts an actual write; only child limit changes.
  process,pipe=start(lab.directory,attempt('alpha',1,'native-write-fault',101),write_limit=True);rows=collect(process,pipe);assert any(row['kind']=='error'and row['errno']==errno.EFBIG for row in rows),'real native file write interruption was hidden or normalized';assert snapshot(lab.directory)==before;native(lab,dict(alpha=a,beta=b))
  # Kill only a known own publisher after private staged bytes, prior to commit.
  other_staging=lab.directory/'.other-team-keep.tmp';other_staging.write_bytes(b'other team opaque staging');entries_before={p.name for p in lab.directory.iterdir()}
  release=CTX.Event();process,pipe=start(lab.directory,attempt('alpha',1,'killed-stage',101),release)
  assert pipe.poll(4)and pipe.recv()['kind']=='staged';native(lab,dict(alpha=a,beta=b));process.kill();process.join(3);pipe.close();assert not process.is_alive()and snapshot(lab.directory)==before
  orphan=[p for p in lab.directory.iterdir()if p.name not in entries_before and not p.name.endswith('.prom')and p.is_file()and not p.is_symlink()]
  original=OSError(errno.EIO,'owned checkpoint fault');stages=[]
  def interrupted(stage):
   stages.append(stage)
   if stage=='staged':native(lab,dict(alpha=a,beta=b));raise original
  caught=None
  try:publisher.publish(lab.directory,REGISTRY,checkpoint=interrupted,**attempt('alpha',1,'stage-error',101))
